meta.name: api-documentation-generator
meta.description: Generate comprehensive API documentation from repository sources including OpenAPI specs, code comments, docstrings, and existing documentation. Use when documenting APIs, creating API reference guides, or summarizing API functionality from codebases. Extracts endpoint details, request/response schemas, authentication methods, and generates code examples. Triggers when users ask to document APIs, generate API docs, create API reference, or summarize API endpoints from a repository.
